443:t_2:107.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「And so the $$イボルバー$$... the humans later called $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, set out into the galaxy.」

443:t_2:108.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The humans who remained decided to move to the Moon and colonies until the environment recovered.」

443:t_2:109.en:
$$ハリー$$
「So they were the ancestors of the $$ムーンレィス$$ and the $$宇宙革命軍$$.」

443:t_2:110.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But humanity remained divided. Some insisted on returning to Earth and chose to live in climate-controlled domes...」

443:t_2:111.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Others chose to live in relatively unpolluted places, such as high latitudes, until the environment recovered.」

443:t_2:112.en:
$$ランド$$
(So that's who those people are...)

443:t_2:113.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「And apart from the $$イボルバー$$, others ventured into the galaxy while retaining human form. They became the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s ancestors.」

443:t_2:114.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So that's the truth of $$黒歴史$$...」

443:t_2:115.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're amazing, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$. Even asleep, you know so much about Earth today.」

443:t_2:116.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I receive this information from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s $$ヴェーダ$$.」

443:t_2:118.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You have access rights to $$ヴェーダ$$?!」

443:t_2:119.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「We were created for the same purpose. Therefore, we were given shared codes.」

443:t_2:120.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ and this $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ facility serve the same purpose...」

443:t_2:121.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Could that be why I could use the $$サテライトキャノン$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$...?!」

443:t_2:122.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Yes. Part of those codes is also used in the signal transmitted by your $$ガンダム$$.」

443:t_2:123.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ must have detected it and activated the necessary systems.」

443:t_2:124.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Now that's a surprise. So old man $$イオリア$$ knew parallel worlds existed even before the $$時空震動$$.」

443:t_2:125.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And this facility and $$ヴェーダ$$ have systems in common...」

443:t_2:126.en:
$$刹那$$
「Other things also exist across parallel worlds...」

443:t_2:128.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. $$クロノ$$ was involved in the circumstances of my creation.」

443:t_2:129.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But the people who created $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ were...」

443:t_2:130.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...Yes. My ancestors created him.」

443:t_2:132.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Yes... The House of $$ソレル$$ appears to have belonged to the organization called $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_2:134.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「By the time I became Queen of the Moon, $$クロノ$$'s existence had already lost its meaning.」

443:t_2:135.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Therefore, I know it only by name. I do not know what its members were working toward.」

443:t_2:137.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Yes... And what I am about to tell you is the truth of $$黒歴史$$ in its deepest sense...」

443:t_2:140.en:
$$葵$$
「Darkness within the black... That sounds serious.」

443:t_2:141.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I never thought the day would come when I would reveal this truth. That is why I did not mention it before.」

443:t_2:142.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But knowing Earth's current situation, I cannot keep this truth from you.」

443:t_2:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it does involve $$クロノ$$...」

443:t_2:144.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「To explain it, I must first tell you the truth about the $$月光蝶$$.」

443:t_2:148.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The $$月光蝶$$ is said to have tried to bury civilization by scattering nanomachines indiscriminately, to end the wars of that age.」

443:t_2:149.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are you saying that isn't true?!」

443:t_2:150.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It is true that it had that aspect.」

443:t_2:151.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But there was a hidden purpose: humanity had to abandon civilization once.」

443:t_2:152.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why on earth did they have to do that?!」

443:t_2:155.en:
$$タケル$$
「So they destroyed civilization to halt evolution...」

443:t_2:156.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. And beyond that, they feared $$ニュータイプ$$s as the first signs of evolution.」

443:t_2:157.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It sounds absurd, but without understanding what it meant, they probably regarded anyone with special abilities as an evolved human.」

443:t_2:159.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Don't look so sad, $$ティファ$$. Ignorant of the truth, they unwittingly gave me eternity, one form of evolution.」

443:t_2:161.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean, $$キリコ$$?」

443:t_2:162.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I've felt it since we arrived. This place resembles 《$$ワイズマン#keyword$$》.」

443:t_2:163.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「The being with extraordinary powers who ruled the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy from the shadows...」

443:t_2:164.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Those who moved their minds into machines and gained eternity...」

443:t_2:165.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Indeed... You could say they and I are the same kind of being.」

443:t_2:166.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That is what I am as $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$. Thanks to that, I can talk to you like this.」

443:t_2:167.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「And they built this facility on the Moon, as part of their duty as $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_2:168.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Was there some significance to this location?」

443:t_2:169.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The Moon is the celestial body nearest to humanity. That is precisely why reaching it has meaning.」

443:t_2:170.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The meaning of humanity venturing into space...」

443:t_2:171.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Yes. In the $$宇宙世紀$$, $$ラプラスの箱$$ likewise originated on the Moon.」

443:t_2:173.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$... What exactly was on the Moon?」

443:t_2:175.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless have no need to know that.」

443:t_2:177.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This is my mercy to you.」

443:t_2:178.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Those explosions...! Is $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ under attack?!」

443:t_2:180.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I'm sorry... I cannot tell you the truth...」

443:t_2:181.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It seems my time to sleep for eternity has come too...」

443:t_2:182.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We'll find the truth on our own! So don't worry about that!」

443:t_2:184.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Don't grieve, $$ティファ$$... Now I too can be freed from living forever...」

443:t_2:185.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「To die... That too is a right granted to living beings.」

443:t_2:186.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Dying is a right too...」

443:t_2:187.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Life is beautiful because it is finite...」

443:t_2:188.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I can... fulfill my duty... and end... my life... That... is a happy... thing...」
